title: Hafta yakuni — 5 ta post
caption: 🗂 Hafta yakuni: eng foydali 5 ta post 1️⃣ Boj 2027-yildan 30 % dan 20 % ga tushadi — qimmat xaridni yanvargacha kutish arziydimi 2️⃣ Buni buyurtma qilmang — vape, lazer, dron va yana 4 ta taqiq 3️⃣ Bir oyda ikkita posilka — norma nega oyga beriladi 4️⃣ Boj qanday hisoblanadi — noutbuk misolida 4 qadam 5️⃣ Braun Series 9 PRO+ — boj bilan ham 2,5 mln so'm tejash 🏷 Hafta chegirmalari: Apple Pencil Pro, Beats Solo 4, LEGO 31134, Belkin Qi2, AirTag 2. Saqlab qo'ying va do'stlaringizga ulashing — ularga ham kerak bo'ladi 📌 ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #digest
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#digest".
2) Center: five small rounded cards stacked in a gentle fan, each with a tiny icon (percent sign, prohibition circle, two parcels, calculator, trophy), with a bookmark ribbon in indigo. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of amber (#F59E0B); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Hafta yakuni"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Eng foydali 5 ta post"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Havolalar postlar kanalga chiqqandan keyin avtomatik qo'yiladi (joylanmagan post — havolasiz matn).
